reason: Hash-bound files named the operator: a home folder, a session scratch folder whose name embeds it, or a fragment of the operator email in a recorded model answer. Each was replaced by a placeholder or a fictional example.com address. Every seal, freeze, report and site-data entry that held an old digest now holds the new one.

re-record.from: an old sha256 listed in digest_map_old_to_new

unchanged: Every other byte of every listed file. Email replacements keep the length, so recorded byte counts stay true. No request payload, request hash, outcome, score, count or cost changed.

composites.rule: sha256 of the files concatenated in this order
